train_metadata.horn_status.notes: Acoustic spectral re-verification confirmed absence of pneumatic horn bursts (300-800 Hz). Only low-frequency diesel engine rumble (50-200 Hz) and ambient crowd noise observed.

timestamps.T0_first_visible.notes: Re-verified Frame 0 (t=0.00s). Left-censored: locomotive is already approaching under flyover at recording start (t <= 0.00s).

timestamps.T1_danger_zone_entry.notes: Re-verified Frame 90 (t=3.00s). Locomotive cowcatcher reaches turnout frog / pedestrian crossing clearance landmark. Note: Prerequisite R03 physical survey boundary uncertified; boundary reflects visual landmark.

timestamps.T2_crossing_occupancy_start.notes: Re-verified Frame 111 (t=3.70s). Locomotive pilot enters transverse roadway occupancy plane on front camera view.

timestamps.T3_locomotive_unit_clearance.notes: Re-verified Frame 105 (t=3.50s). Rear buffer/coupler of lead locomotive unit clears roadway corridor, transitioning to first passenger coach.

timestamps.T4_tail_clearance.notes: Re-verified Frame 900 (t=30.00s). Trailing buffer of final coach (#5) clears crossing line. Immediate crowd ingress across tracks commences.

timestamps.T_scene_clear.notes: Re-verified Frame 975 (t=32.50s). Entire train recedes past camera sightlines.

camera_alignment.offset_s.notes: Prerequisite R04 inter-camera temporal offset remains UNRESOLVED without empirical hardware sync pulse. Front and back camera timelines verified independently on separate native clocks.

general_review_notes: Stage 2 Verification: All visual and acoustic boundaries for event_011 re-verified against physical frames. Candidate boundaries (7 accepted, 1 marked unobservable) confirmed physically consistent. Trailing coach count (5) verified.
